source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U06: Reconcile liquidation,workmen dues and IBC before distributing secured proceeds

payload.title: Identify the insolvency regime before the distribution
payload.core_explanation_md:
The retained section 13(9) is expressly subject to the IBC and contains liquidation/workmen-dues provisos using their stated statutory references. The described mechanism includes a liquidator estimate where dues are not yet ascertainable, a deposit and later adjustment, with the required undertaking. An estimate is not automatically the final discharge of the workmen component.

Do not copy an older Companies Act reference into an IBC liquidation waterfall without reconciling the governing regime, commencement, savings and the secured creditor election. A section 13(7) arithmetic exercise that expressly excludes other priorities does not decide an actual insolvency distribution. Preserve the liquidator communication, security realisation choice and applicable order before allocating money.

self_check.prompt_text: Does paying an estimated workmen amount automatically end every later adjustment duty?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The retained provisos contemplate reconciliation of the final amount.

payload.stem_md: A creditor deposits the liquidator estimated workmen dues and refuses any final reconciliation solely because an estimate was paid. What does the retained provision require considering?

options.text_md: Only whether the estimate was convenient
A rule that every estimate is permanently conclusive

options.explanation_md: It does not determine the balance.

options.text_md: The final dues, balance/excess adjustment and undertaking
options.explanation_md: The estimate does not erase reconciliation.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The estimate does not erase reconciliation.

payload.stem_md: A distribution memo says SARFAESI automatically overrides every IBC rule. What source qualification was missed?

options.text_md: The express subject-to-IBC qualification and applicable regime
options.explanation_md: The statutes cannot be combined through that blanket claim.

options.text_md: A rule that security can never have priority

options.explanation_md: Preference does not set statutory priority.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The statutes cannot be combined through that blanket claim.
